##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 16 October 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure will build over the Irish Sea today, though with a rather unstable atmosphere this afternoon and evening.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, gradually veering northeast 3 or 4 by tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate this evening until later in the night.


##Weather##

Showers until later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers until later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northeast 3 or 4, gradually becoming east or northeast 2 to 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
